rows.grounds: third-person pronoun referring to the rajasic type

items.question: What marks the rajasic practitioner among the three guna-types?
items.inference: The rajasic practitioner is defined by passion and desire for passion.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical role of rāgakāṅkṣaṇaḥ is uncertain.
items.plain_english: He is rajasic, O great lady, passion-souled and desiring passion.
